description: Prompt for classifying a block as a harness, project or environment issue, with its reasoning, for the grouped engines' Blocked (ASS-107; ASS-163: a project issue is checked against the latest master before any bug is raised): where its fix is made

input-arguments.name: problem
input-arguments.description: The checked analysis of the problem: summary, root cause, evidence
input-arguments.example: Dev container needs rebuilding: node 24 image changed

issue.description: Where the fix is made: harness (a fix ticket in the harness project's backlog), project (the cause is in the project's own code: checked against the latest master next, a bug raised in the project's own ticket system only when it fails there; the harness's backlog on the harness project), environment (where the work runs: repaired in place, else by the operator)

own-branch.description: Project only (ASS-384): true when the cause is in what the ticket's own branch adds or changes (Troubleshoot's failing-file), not in master's code; the harness checks master and the branch, then sends the ticket back to Generate Solution; left out otherwise

human-action.description: Environment only: what the operator must do should it not be repaired in place; left out otherwise
